Standard.description: This entity blends seamlessly into its surroundings, its hues and patterns mirroring the natural palette of its habitat, ensuring it remains a cryptic figure in the eyes of both predator and prey.

Melanistic.flavor: Pitch black, blending perfectly into the shadows.
Melanistic.description: Endowed with the Melanistic trait, this entity's skin and eyes are a deep, inky black, allowing it to blend seamlessly into the darkest shadows, enhancing its agility and stealth.

Albino.flavor: Stark white with red eyes, highly visible but imposing.
Albino.description: An unnerving figure with stark white skin and piercing red eyes, the albino stands out under any light, their imposing presence marred only by a slight reduction in agility and reflexes.

Leucistic.flavor: Pale and ghostly white, but with normal pigment in the eyes.
Leucistic.description: Enveloped in an otherworldly, ghostly pallor, the leucistic entity stands out with a haunting beauty, its piercing eyes the only hint of its natural pigmentation, a silent whisper of the dark magic that fuels its existence, yet its ghostly form imposes a slight burden on its agility.

Erythristic.flavor: Possessing an unusual, vibrant reddish-copper hue.
Erythristic.description: The Erythristic component is a mesmerizing anomaly, its flesh pulsating with an otherworldly, vibrant reddish-copper hue that seems to shift and shimmer in the dim light, hinting at its deep connection to arcane energies.

Xanthic.description: The Xanthic is a disturbing anomaly, its skin tinged with a sickly, golden-yellow hue that seems to pulse faintly in the dim light, a stark reminder of its unnatural origins, yet its agility is slightly marred by the burden of this twisted mutation.

Piebald.flavor: Large, unpigmented white patches breaking up its base color.
Piebald.description: The Piebald component is marked by vast, stark white patches that contrast sharply with its otherwise dark, mottled hide, creating a striking and unsettling pattern that seems almost otherworldly in its symmetry and scale.
